messages:
Nina Park: Quick thread - NovoCare wants feature-level RFC: compare Redwood's Hosted/Dedicated/Private for their RFP. They also need a POC schedule and an itemized cost estimate. Attached: novocare_rfp.xlsx

Ethan Rogers: Got it. Which compliance baseline are we comparing against? They mentioned HIPAA + SOC2.

Security Bot: We meet SOC2 Type II and have HIPAA BAA option via enterprise contract. Recommend sending redacted SOC2 + BAAs terms.

Nina Park: Also flag that they asked about model provenance and ability to lock model versions. Important for their regulated outputs.

Product Ops: Will add rows for model pinning, rollout controls, and eval hooks to capability matrix.

Ethan Rogers: I'll draft the POC timeline and three price tiers. Will include assumptions on avg token length and concurrency.

Security Bot: Uploaded attachments: soc2_redacted.pdf, hipaa_baa_summary.pdf, rfp_response_template.docx

Nina Park: Action: Ethan to deliver novocare_matrix.xlsx and novocare_pricing.pdf by Thu. Security to complete questionnaire answers.
